development_corpus_exclusions.rule: No paper used in the active nine-paper EXTRACT research corpus may count toward held-out semantic acceptance.

selection_policy.source: Open-access primary research discovered independently of Local EXTRACT outputs.
selection_policy.freshness: Prefer papers not previously used by the Local EXTRACT development corpus, with a mix of mature 2024 work and fresh 2026 work.
exclusions: papers already in the development corpus
papers lacking an authoritative open PDF
papers whose benchmark role is only tangential to RF/RFF evidence extraction
selection_policy.anti_cherry_pick_rule: Paper split and roles are frozen before source-first gold annotation and before any Local EXTRACT evaluation on these papers.

pilot_papers.title: DeepCRF: Deep Learning-Enhanced CSI-Based RF Fingerprinting for Channel-Resilient WiFi Device Identification
pilot_papers.role_rationale: Mature channel-resilience case with quantitative unseen-condition results; used to validate annotation mechanics, not final acceptance.

pilot_papers.title: Domain-Agnostic Hardware Fingerprinting-Based Device Identifier for Zero-Trust IoT Security
pilot_papers.role_rationale: Cross-day/cross-location device-identification paper with security framing and multiple evaluation regimes; pilot only.

acceptance_papers.title: Sequential RF Fingerprinting for AIS: Rejecting Unknown Vessels and Insider MMSI Spoofs Days After Enrollment
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Combines unseen-device rejection, insider-spoof detection, temporal drift, calibration, and quantitative operational metrics.

acceptance_papers.title: From Identification to Discovery: Holistic RF Fingerprinting via Learning-Aided Quantization
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Single architecture spanning closed-set identification, open-set recognition, and novel-class discovery across LoRa/WiFi.

acceptance_papers.title: TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Reliability under receiver/distance/day/environment shift, calibrated trust, evidence acquisition, and accept/reject/defer behavior.

acceptance_papers.title: SFPF: Spatio-Frequency Polarization Fingerprint for Anomalous Wireless Device Detection
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Hardware-integrity/anomaly detection with simulation and experimental metrics over SNR and observation dimensions.

acceptance_papers.title: Adaptive Distributed Physical-Layer Authentication and Attack Detection in 6G Non-Terrestrial Networks via Causal Meta-Learning
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Multi-feature physical-layer authentication under distribution shift with causal/meta-learning and conditional localization.

acceptance_papers.title: From Identification to Authentication for Micro-CSI RF Fingerprinting in OFDM Systems
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Authentication and adversarial spoofing case with analytical derivations and experimental validation.

acceptance_papers.title: RF Fingerprinting of DSP Implementations using Machine Learning: An Over-the-Air Case Study
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Distinct fingerprint source (DSP implementation rather than hardware imperfections), OTA evaluation, SNR/bandwidth analysis.

acceptance_papers.title: A Multi-Scenario UAV RF Dataset with Real-World Acquisition and Signal Processing Benchmarking
acceptance_papers.role_rationale: Real-world dataset/acquisition paper covering 26 UAVs, multiple operating conditions, receiver configurations, and interference-aware scenarios.

contamination_policy.failed_acceptance_result_reuse_rule: If a failed acceptance run materially informs architecture tuning, subsequent promotion requires a new untouched holdout set for an unbiased claim.
